lesson.title: Sample Lesson: Choosing and Personalizing an AI Assistant

audience: Working professionals who have tried an AI assistant a few times and want a dependable everyday routine.

sections.title: Why this lesson
sections.objective: Frame the lesson: one assistant, chosen on purpose and set up once, beats several assistants used at random.

beats.summary: Title card for the standalone sample lesson and its one goal.

title: Choosing and personalizing
an *AI assistant*
content.sub: A synthetic sample lesson that exercises the whole pipeline.

beats.summary: Reframe: the habit of using one tool well matters more than which tool.

content.quote: Pick one assistant on purpose, set it up once, and it starts working the way you do.

sections.title: The plan for this lesson
sections.objective: Preview the four steps the lesson walks through.

beats.summary: Four stops: meet the assistants, compare them, personalize one, practice.

sections.title: Four assistants in this course
sections.objective: Introduce the four assistant profiles, grounded in content/tools.

beats.summary: One card per assistant, auto-populated from the tool profiles.

sections.title: What each assistant can do
sections.objective: Compare capabilities from the codified facts, including one honest limitation.

beats.summary: Capability table derived from grounding; call out that Claude does not generate raster images.

sections.title: Set it up once
sections.objective: Show the two settings that make an assistant feel like yours: personalization and persistent context.

beats.summary: Four setup moves across personalization and persistent context.

features.title: Tell it about you
features.sub: Your role, your audience, and the work you do most.

features.title: Set the answer style
features.sub: Default length, tone, and format for replies.

features.title: Let it remember
features.sub: Memory carries what it learns from one chat to the next.

features.title: Keep a project space
features.sub: Group related chats, files, and instructions in one place.

sections.title: What you have now
sections.objective: Consolidate the three takeaways and point to the next lesson.

beats.summary: Three recap cards plus a next-up preview.
